achievements.name: Stand Alone
achievements.description: Complete Always Faithful.

steps: Play and complete the campaign mission 'Always Faithful'.
This is the first campaign mission — story progression only.

achievements.name: Rock of Gibraltar
achievements.description: Complete The Rock and Operation Gladius.

steps: Complete the campaign missions 'The Rock' and 'Operation Gladius'.
These are consecutive story missions — play through the campaign.

achievements.name: Devil in the Dark
achievements.description: Complete Night Raid.

steps: Complete the campaign mission 'Night Raid'.
This is a stealth-focused mission — story progression only.

achievements.name: Secret Service
achievements.description: Complete No Sleep and Moving Mountains.

steps: Complete the campaign missions 'No Sleep' and 'Moving Mountains'.
Continue the campaign to reach these missions.

achievements.name: High Roller
achievements.description: Complete Nile Guard.

steps: Complete the campaign mission 'Nile Guard'.
Story progression only.

achievements.name: Damned If You Do
achievements.description: Complete Operation Ember Strike.

steps: Complete the campaign mission 'Operation Ember Strike'.
This is a late-game campaign mission.

achievements.name: Cloak and Dagger
achievements.description: Complete the Battlefield 6 Campaign.

steps: Complete all campaign missions from start to finish.
Play through the entire story on any difficulty.

achievements.name: In Memoriam
achievements.description: Pick up a Campaign collectible.

steps: Find and pick up any collectible item during a campaign mission.
Collectibles are dog tags scattered throughout levels.

achievements.name: Dogs of War
achievements.description: Pick up 5 Campaign collectibles.

steps: Find and collect 5 dog tag collectibles across campaign missions.
Explore off the main path — collectibles are often in side areas.

achievements.name: Hounds of War
achievements.description: Pick up 10 Campaign collectibles.

steps: Collect 10 dog tags across the campaign.
Some are well hidden — check rooms, rooftops, and behind cover.

achievements.name: Wolves of War
achievements.description: Pick up 20 Campaign collectibles.

steps: Collect 20 campaign dog tags. Check every mission for hidden collectibles.
Use mission replay to go back for missed ones.

achievements.name: Pack Leader
achievements.description: Pick up all Campaign collectibles.

steps: Find every collectible dog tag in the entire campaign.
Use a collectibles guide or video walkthrough to ensure you don't miss any.
You can replay missions to pick up missed ones.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: There are collectibles in every mission. Some are very well hidden behind destructible walls or in hard-to-reach spots.

achievements.name: Peak Performance
achievements.description: Complete a Single Player mission on the hardest difficulty.

steps: Set the difficulty to the highest setting (Realistic/Hardcore).
Complete any single campaign mission on this difficulty.
'Always Faithful' is the shortest mission — good candidate for this.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: You die very quickly on hardest difficulty. Take it slow, use cover constantly, and learn enemy positions.

achievements.name: Liquidator
achievements.description: Headshot kill 50 Enemies in the Campaign.

steps: Get 50 headshot kills total across all campaign missions.
Use assault rifles or semi-auto weapons for easier headshots.
Cumulative across all missions and replays.

achievements.name: One Stone
achievements.description: Eliminate 3 enemies with a single grenade in Single Player.

steps: Wait for enemies to cluster together (common during scripted encounters).
Throw a frag grenade into the group to kill 3+ at once.
'Always Faithful' has good grouped enemy encounters early on.

achievements.name: Armor Annihilation
achievements.description: Destroy 10 enemy vehicles in Single Player.

steps: Destroy 10 enemy vehicles total across the campaign.
Use rockets, C4, or mounted weapons to take out APCs, tanks, and helicopters.
Cumulative across all missions.

achievements.name: End of an Era
achievements.description: Find the dinosaur figurine in the NATO base in Always Faithful.

steps: During the 'Always Faithful' mission, explore the NATO base area.
Look for a small dinosaur figurine hidden on a shelf or desk.
This is a classic Battlefield easter egg.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Classic DICE easter egg! The dinosaur is in a building to the left of the main path. Check all shelves.

achievements.name: Efficiency
achievements.description: Destroy 10 mannequins in The Rock.

steps: During 'The Rock' mission, look for destructible mannequins throughout the level.
Shoot or melee 10 of them. They're scattered in buildings and rooms.

achievements.name: Deep-Six
achievements.description: Destroy 3 floating mines in Operation Gladius.

steps: During 'Operation Gladius', look for floating naval mines in the water.
Shoot 3 of them to detonate and destroy them.

achievements.name: Sidearm Savant
achievements.description: Complete Night Raid using only pistols, knives, or gadgets.

steps: Play the 'Night Raid' mission and only use pistols, knives, or gadgets for all kills.
Do NOT fire any primary weapons (rifles, SMGs, etc.).
This is a stealth mission so knife takedowns are your best friend.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Play on the easiest difficulty. Use stealth takedowns with the knife for most of it, pistol only when spotted.
warnings: Firing any primary weapon voids the achievement. Only sidearms, melee, and gadgets are allowed.

achievements.name: Looks Like A Nail
achievements.description: Kill five enemies with a sledgehammer in No Sleep.

steps: During the 'No Sleep' mission, find and equip the sledgehammer.
Kill 5 enemies with it in melee combat.
Play on easy difficulty to survive getting close to enemies.

achievements.name: Bullseye Blitz
achievements.description: Land six consecutive headshots in Moving Mountains.

steps: During 'Moving Mountains', get 6 headshot kills in a row with no body/miss shots between them.
Use a scoped weapon and take your time. A semi-auto rifle works best.
Play on easy difficulty so enemies don't push you.
warnings: Any non-headshot kill or missed shot breaks the streak. Must be 6 consecutive.

achievements.name: Roadside Assistance
achievements.description: Collapse an overpass on a tank in Nile Guard.

steps: During 'Nile Guard', look for a destructible overpass/bridge support.
Destroy the support when an enemy tank is driving underneath.
The overpass will collapse onto the tank.

achievements.name: Being Watched
achievements.description: Spot a total of 20 enemies with your drone in Operation Ember Strike.

steps: During 'Operation Ember Strike', use your recon drone frequently.
Spot/tag 20 enemies total with the drone's marking system.

achievements.name: No Reinforcements
achievements.description: Shoot down the reinforcement chopper with a tank during Always Forward.

steps: During 'Always Forward' (part of Always Faithful), you'll have access to a tank.
When an enemy helicopter arrives with reinforcements, shoot it down using the tank's main cannon.
Lead your shots — the helicopter is a moving target.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The chopper appears at a scripted moment. Save before it arrives and retry until you land the shot.

achievements.name: Private First Class Montes
achievements.description: Reach Rank 9.

steps: Play multiplayer matches and earn XP to reach Rank 9.
All game modes contribute to rank progression.

achievements.name: Lance Corporal Matkovic
achievements.description: Reach Rank 14.

steps: Continue playing multiplayer to reach Rank 14.
Focus on objective play for bonus XP.

achievements.name: Sergeant Redford
achievements.description: Reach Rank 25.

steps: Reach Rank 25 in multiplayer. Requires significant playtime.
Play Conquest or Breakthrough for the highest XP yields.

achievements.name: Punished
achievements.description: Get 129 kills in Multiplayer.

steps: Accumulate 129 kills in any multiplayer mode.
Cumulative across all matches.

achievements.name: Medal of Honor
achievements.description: Commit 414 acts of valor in Multiplayer.

steps: Acts of valor include kills, assists, revives, captures, and other objective actions.
Play regularly and focus on objective play to accumulate 414.

achievements.name: Road Rash
achievements.description: Get a Roadkill with vehicles in Multiplayer.

steps: Hop into any vehicle in a multiplayer match.
Run over an enemy player to get a roadkill.

achievements.name: Front line
achievements.description: Take or Defend 41 sectors in Breakthrough.

steps: Play Breakthrough mode and participate in sector captures/defenses.
Accumulate 41 total sector takes or defenses — cumulative.

achievements.name: Wrench Monkey
achievements.description: Repair vehicles for 2042 damage in Multiplayer.

steps: Equip the repair tool and follow friendly vehicles into battle.
Repair damaged vehicles for a cumulative total of 2042 damage repaired.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The 2042 number is a nod to Battlefield 2042. Follow tanks around and repair them during pushes.

achievements.name: Heavy Weaponry
achievements.description: Get 5 kills with LMGs without reloading in Multiplayer.

steps: Equip an LMG as the Support class.
Get 5 kills in a single magazine without reloading.
Find a chokepoint or flank to catch multiple enemies.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Use an LMG with a large magazine (100+ rounds). Breakthrough defense is great for this — enemies funnel through tight areas.

achievements.name: Five by Five
achievements.description: Get 5 multi-kills as Assault in Multiplayer.

steps: Play as the Assault class and get multi-kills (2+ kills in quick succession).
Use explosives, vehicles, or rapid-fire weapons on groups.
Accumulate 5 multi-kills total — cumulative.

achievements.name: Stolz der Nation
achievements.description: Get 250 sniper rifle kills as Recon in Multiplayer.

steps: Play as the Recon class and get 250 kills with sniper rifles.
This is a significant grind — focus on modes with long sightlines like Conquest.
Cumulative across all matches.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Play on large maps with open sightlines. Breakthrough defense is great for sniping attackers.

achievements.name: A Joyful Nurse
achievements.description: Revive 1996 players as Support in Multiplayer.

steps: Play as the Support class and revive downed teammates.
Accumulate 1996 revives total — this is a massive grind.
Focus on Breakthrough and Conquest where revive opportunities are frequent.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The 1996 number references the year DICE was founded. This is one of the longest grinds in the game.
Reddit tip: Play Breakthrough on offense — lots of teammates go down pushing objectives.
warnings: This is the single biggest grind in the game. Expect hundreds of hours of dedicated Support play.

achievements.name: Command and Conquest 2
achievements.description: Capture 128 objectives in Conquest.

steps: Play Conquest mode and capture objectives by standing in the capture zone.
Accumulate 128 objective captures — cumulative.

achievements.name: Super Bomb man
achievements.description: Arm or disarm 5 M-COM explosives in a Multiplayer match.

steps: Play a Rush mode match (M-COM based objective mode).
Arm or disarm M-COM stations — you need 5 interactions in a single match.
Use smoke grenades to cover your approach to M-COMs.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Both arming (attack) and disarming (defense) count. Switch sides to maximize attempts.

achievements.description: Get 6 sidearm headshot kills in a Multiplayer match.

steps: In a single multiplayer match, get 6 headshot kills with a sidearm (pistol).
Use a high-damage pistol. Finish wounded enemies with headshots.
Play a long match mode like Conquest for more opportunity.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Weaken enemies with your primary, then switch to pistol for the headshot finish. Very hard to do with pistol alone.

achievements.name: A Little C-4 Knocking on Your Door
achievements.description: Deal 2000 damage to enemy vehicles with the Demolition Charge.

steps: Equip Demolition Charges (C4) and stick them on enemy vehicles.
Deal 2000 cumulative vehicle damage with C4 across all matches.
Place C4 on roads where vehicles pass and detonate remotely.

achievements.name: First Blood 2
achievements.description: Perform 10 takedowns in a Multiplayer match.

steps: Get 10 melee takedowns in a single multiplayer match.
Flank the enemy team and approach from behind for takedown prompts.
Play Breakthrough on close-quarters maps for best results.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Extremely hard in normal play. Look for AFK/camping players or flank during smoke pushes.

achievements.name: Collector
achievements.description: Loot 10 Superior or Unique items.

steps: In REDSEC (Battle Royale), loot 10 items of Superior or Unique rarity.
Search supply caches and high-value loot zones.

achievements.name: May the Odds Forever Be in Your Favor
achievements.description: Play 74 matches in any version of Battle Royale.

steps: Play 74 matches of REDSEC Battle Royale (any mode: Solo, Duos, Squads).
You don't need to win — just complete matches.

achievements.name: Here's Your Birthday Present
achievements.description: Deploy 42 call-ins.

steps: In REDSEC, use call-in items (airstrikes, supply drops, vehicles) 42 times total.
Cumulative across all Battle Royale matches.

achievements.name: Stone Cold
achievements.description: Stun enemies 316 times in Battle Royale or Gauntlet.

steps: Use stun grenades, flashbangs, or stun-based gadgets to stun enemies.
Accumulate 316 total stuns across all REDSEC matches.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Equip stun grenades every match and throw them into fights. Gauntlet mode may be faster for this.

achievements.name: Rise from Your Grave
achievements.description: Revive teammates 1988 times in Battle Royale or Gauntlet.

steps: Revive downed teammates 1988 times total in REDSEC modes.
Play Duos or Squads for revive opportunities. This is an extreme grind.
warnings: One of the hardest grinds — 1988 revives requires hundreds of matches. Queue with friends who are willing to go down.

achievements.name: Army of Two
achievements.description: Win 7 matches in Battle Royale: Duos.

steps: Play REDSEC Battle Royale in Duos mode.
Win 7 matches — must be #1 placement.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Play with a coordinated partner. Stick together and play for endgame positioning.

achievements.name: Never-Ending Game
achievements.description: Play 125 rounds of Gauntlet.

steps: Play 125 total rounds of the Gauntlet mode in REDSEC.
You don't need to win — just play through rounds.

achievements.name: Everybody Fights, Nobody Quits
achievements.description: Win a Battle Royale match as a full squad with total squad survival.

steps: Win a REDSEC Battle Royale Squads match where no squad member is eliminated at any point.
All teammates must survive from start to finish.
Play extremely cautiously — avoid early fights and position for endgame.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Coordinate with a full squad of friends. Play passively, avoid hot drops, and only fight when necessary at the end.
warnings: If ANY squad member goes down at any point during the match, the achievement is voided.

achievements.name: Mission Accepted
achievements.description: Complete 214 missions in any version of Battle Royale.

steps: In-match missions appear during REDSEC Battle Royale.
Complete 214 total missions across all matches — cumulative.

achievements.name: Dog of War
achievements.description: Collect 9 dog tags in Battle Royale or Gauntlet.

steps: Collect dog tags from eliminated players in REDSEC modes.
Pick up 9 total across all matches.

achievements.name: Mozambique Here!
achievements.description: Ping a Shotgun in Battle Royale.

steps: In a REDSEC Battle Royale match, find a shotgun on the ground.
Use the ping/comm system to mark it for your team.
